title: Figure 4: Wigner function for a vacuum (top) and for a coherent state (bottom)
description: Two 3D wireframe surface plots, each showing a single narrow sharp peak rising from a flat gridded plane, the lower peak displaced from center. Caption reads "Figure 4. Wigner Function for a Vacuum (top) and for a Coherent State (bottom)." It notes coherent states are "displaced vacua" reconstructed by optical homodyne tomography (courtesy of Ulf Leonhardt).
